question: When we cut an onion, the vegetable emits an odour and our eyes tear up. Which of the following compounds is responsible for the tears and odour resulting from freshly cut onions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sulphuric acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **When an onion is cut or cut, the cells of the onion release these compounds into the air**__. When this happens, the "enzyme" works to convert the amino acids into lachrymator compounds. __**This form of sulfuric acid irritates the nerves around the eyes causing them to shed tears**__.

 __
 
• **Lachrymatory **factor synthase is released into the** air** when we **cut an onion.**
 
• The** synthase enzyme** converts the **amino acids sulfoxides **of the** onion **into **sulfenic acid.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Acid **
 **Details**
 
 

 Ascorbic acid
 
 
 
• Ascorbic Acid is a natural water-soluble vitamin (Vitamin C). Ascorbic acid is a potent reducing and antioxidant agent that functions in fighting bacterial infections.
 
• Formula: C6H8O6
 
 
 
 

 Citric acid
 
 
 
• It is a colorless weak organic acid. It occurs naturally in citrus fruits.
 
• Formula: C₆H₈O₇
 
 
 
 

 Acetic acid
 
 
 
• Acetic Acid is a synthetic carboxylic acid with antibacterial and antifungal properties.
 
• Formula: CH₃COOH.
